descriptionZhHans: 当代中国商业背景下的财务报告框架；利用相关财务分析工具分析和评价财务报告的能力；应用相关财务分析工具进行商业估值和财务决策的能力。

descriptionEn: This course aims to enable students to strengthen domestic and international financial accounting theories and practical skills, as well as comprehensively explore the development process and trends of domestic and international financial accounting, and foster strategic mindset and global insights.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在使学生能够加强国内和国际金融会计理论和实践技能，并全面探索国内和国际金融会计的发展过程和趋势，培养战略思维和全球洞察力。

titleEn: Management Accounting Issues in Multinational Enterprises

titleZhHant: 多國企業的管理會計問題

descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在爲學生提供便利：獲取管理會計問題的核心知識；發展應用管理會計創新的能力，以促進和實現業務戰略；從國際角度獲取文化差異、業務動態和專業精神的核心知識。

titleEn: Strategic Management Accounting and Internal Control
descriptionEn: This course aims to: Integrate knowledge from different topics in Management Accounting and other related arena of knowledge to help students solve complex real-life business problems; Help students develop skills in performing analysis and reporting, both orally and in written form, by using real-life cases in management accounting.
titleZhHans: 战略管理会计和内部控制
titleZhHant: 戰略管理會計和內部控制
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在：整合管理会计和其他相关知识领域不同课题的知识，以帮助学生解决复杂的现实生活中的商业问题；帮助学生通过在管理会计中使用真实生活中的案例，发展以口头和书面形式进行分析和报告的技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在：整合管理會計和其他相關知識領域不同課題的知識，以幫助學生解決複雜的現實生活中的商業問題；幫助學生通過在管理會計中使用真實生活中的案例，發展以口頭和書面形式進行分析和報告的技能。

descriptionEn: This course aims to: describe the legal and regulatory framework of taxation in the Chinese Mainland. provide students with knowledge of value added tax, consumption tax, individual income tax, enterprise income tax, customs duty, land appreciation tax and tax administration. provide students with tax control knowledge under the digital economy environment. provide students with knowledge and cases of finance management and taxation in the Chinese Mainland.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在：描述中国内地税收的法律法规框架，为学生提供增值税，消费税，个人所得税，企业所得税，关税，土地保值税和税收管理等方面的知识，为学生提供数字经济环境下的税收控制知识，为学生提供中国内地财务管理和税收方面的知识和案例。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在：描述中國內地稅收的法律法規框架，爲學生提供增值稅，消費稅，個人所得稅，企業所得稅，關稅，土地保值稅和稅收管理等方面的知識，爲學生提供數字經濟環境下的稅收控制知識，爲學生提供中國內地財務管理和稅收方面的知識和案例。

titleEn: Corporate Social Responsibilities and Accounting Ethics
descriptionEn: This course aims to: Explore the ethical dimensions of accounting and business practice, relationship of accounting and business ethics, and the general ethics and ethical foundations upon which accounting and business practices are based.

titleZhHant: 公司社會責任和會計道德

descriptionZhHant: 本課程旨在：探索會計和業務慣例的道德層面，會計與商業道德的關係，以及會計和業務慣例所依據的一般道德和道德基礎。

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce the study of financial laws and regulations, and the regulatory framework within which the business and public sector operate in Hong Kong and China, and to study the rules governing the operation of multinational organizations operating in the Chinese Mainland.

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with the finance knowledge and relevant skills required to make corporate financial decisions like cashflow management and investment and financing decisions.

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce students to the audit practice environment and foundations for audit judgement as specified below: provide knowledge of the regulatory, legal and reporting framework of auditing in Hong Kong provide knowledge of basic principles, objectives and ethical requirements of auditing develop analytical ability to identify risks in auditing develop practical skills to conduct an audit, individually and with a team develop communication skills for effective communication both in the written and verbal forms.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍审计实践环境和审计判断的基础，具体如下：提供香港审计的监管、法律和报告框架知识 提供审计的基本原则、目标和道德要求知识 发展识别审计风险的分析能力 发展开展审计的实用技能 个人和团队发展沟通技能，以书面和口头形式进行有效沟通。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹審計實踐環境和審計判斷的基礎，具體如下：提供香港審計的監管、法律和報告框架知識 提供審計的基本原則、目標和道德要求知識 發展識別審計風險的分析能力 發展開展審計的實用技能 個人和團隊發展溝通技能，以書面和口頭形式進行有效溝通。

descriptionEn: This course aims to: provide students with knowledge about taxes relating to property, salaries and profits, tax depreciation allowances, personal assessment, anti-tax avoidance, tax management, stamp duty and tax administration develop students' analytical ability to solve technical tax problems in a systematic way, with consideration to tax and non-tax issues develop students' generic skills in interpersonal interaction, working individually and in team situations develop students' ethical outlook and sense of professional integrity when dealing with tax related issues.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在：向学生提供财产税，工资和利润税，税收折旧津贴，个人评估，反税避税，税收管理，印花税和税收管理等方面的知识，培养学生系统地解决技术税问题的分析能力，同时考虑税收和非税收问题，培养学生在人际互动方面的通用技能，在个人和团队情况下工作，在处理税收相关问题时培养学生的道德观和职业诚信感。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在：向學生提供財產稅，工資和利潤稅，稅收折舊津貼，個人評估，反稅避稅，稅收管理，印花稅和稅收管理等方面的知識，培養學生系統地解決技術稅問題的分析能力，同時考慮稅收和非稅收問題，培養學生在人際互動方面的通用技能，在個人和團隊情況下工作，在處理稅收相關問題時培養學生的道德觀和職業誠信感。

descriptionEn: This course is designed to introduce a variety of topics about the systems used by a company to process its accounting information.

descriptionZhHant: 這一課程旨在介紹公司處理其會計信息所使用的各種系統。

titleZhHans: 公司和证券条例与惯例
titleZhHant: 公司和證券條例與慣例

descriptionEn: This course aims to enable students appreciate the regulatory framework, theories and practices of corporate risk management both from a regional and a global perspective, and acquire knowledge and skills in evaluating various risk scenarios and organisational risk management strategies as well as developing organisational culture and behaviour on risk management practices.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在使学生能够从区域和全球角度了解企业风险管理的监管框架、理论和做法，并获得知识和技能来评价各种风险假设和组织风险管理战略，以及发展关于风险管理做法的组织文化和行为。

titleEn: Credentials and Essential Soft Skills for Effective Board Management

titleZhHans: 证书和理事会有效管理的基本软技能
titleZhHant: 證書和理事會有效管理的基本軟技能

descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生提供关于会计概念的基本知识、关于AI的知识及其在会计和商业中的作用。

descriptionZhHans: 这个课程是为学习会计和财务研究的学生设计的，他们有兴趣学习如何管理数据，进行商业分析，应用AI模型实现会计和鉴证过程自动化，并开发预测模型以提高利润或回报。
descriptionZhHant: 這個課程是爲學習會計和財務研究的學生設計的，他們有興趣學習如何管理數據，進行商業分析，應用AI模型實現會計和鑑證過程自動化，並開發預測模型以提高利潤或回報。

descriptionEn: - Provide real-life working experience in local and/or international contexts for at least 4 weeks or 150 work hours; - Develop an in-depth and practical understanding of business operations and the professional environment by applying the theoretical knowledge, concepts and practical skills of accounting and business learnt in the formal curriculum; - Sharpen students' skills in effective communication, individual and team work, time management, data analysis and reporting; and - Develop students' ability to apply theoretical knowledge and explore different ways to solve real-life problem(s)…
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year

descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生掌握古典汉语的全面，基本知识，并用学习发现的方法，向他们介绍分析用古典汉语写成的选定散文的一般原则。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生掌握古典漢語的全面，基本知識，並用學習發現的方法，向他們介紹分析用古典漢語寫成的選定散文的一般原則。

descriptionEn: This course introduces students to Chinese exegesis (xungu xue 訓詁學), a practical and integrative branch of Chinese philology focused on analyzing the meanings of words in ancient Chinese texts through the linguistic analysis of sounds, scripts, and grammar.
descriptionZhHans: 本课程向学生介绍汉语释义(xungu xue Q ⁇ ),是中国哲学的一个实用综合分支，主要通过语音，脚本，语法等语言分析来分析古代汉语文本中词汇的含义。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程向學生介紹漢語釋義(xungu xue Q ⁇ ),是中國哲學的一個實用綜合分支，主要通過語音，腳本，語法等語言分析來分析古代漢語文本中詞彙的含義。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students acquire analytical and research ability in the study of Chinese and provide them with an academic grounding for graduate studies in Chinese documentology, using a learning-centric approach.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生在汉语学习中获得分析和研究能力，并采用以学习为中心的方法，为他们提供中文文献学研究生的学术基础。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生在漢語學習中獲得分析和研究能力，並採用以學習爲中心的方法，爲他們提供中文文獻學研究生的學術基礎。

titleEn: Selected Readings in Chinese Women Literature
descriptionEn: This course offers an overview of the historical development of Chinese women's literature from the Qin-Han periods to contemporary China.
descriptionZhHans: 本课程概括了中国妇女文学从秦汉时期到当代中国的历史发展。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程概括了中國婦女文學從秦漢時期到當代中國的歷史發展。

descriptionEn: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of classical Chinese fiction and "xiqu戲曲" (traditional Chinese drama), through a dual lens of theoretical inquiry and practical learning.
descriptionZhHans: 本课程通过理论探究和实践学习的双重视角，全面探索古典中国小说和"xiqu ⁇ "(中国传统戏剧).
descriptionZhHant: 本課程通過理論探究和實踐學習的雙重視角，全面探索古典中國小說和"xiqu ⁇ "(中國傳統戲劇).

titleEn: Great Works in Classical Chinese Literature I: From Pre-Qin Period to Six Dynasties
descriptionEn: This course aims to develop students' advanced knowledge of the features of Chinese literature, and the inter-relationship between literature, society and culture before the Tang Dynasty.
titleZhHans: 古典中国文学大作一：从先秦时期到六朝
titleZhHant: 古典中國文學大作一：從先秦時期到六朝
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在培养学生对中国文学特色的先进知识，以及唐朝之前的文学，社会和文化的相互关系。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在培養學生對中國文學特色的先進知識，以及唐朝之前的文學，社會和文化的相互關係。

titleEn: Great Works in Classical Chinese Literature II: From Tang Dynasty to Qing Dynasty
descriptionEn: This course aims to develop students' advanced knowledge of Chinese literature from Tang Dynasty to Qing Dynasty by selecting great works and discussing their features and the intellectual, cultural, and social background that shaped them.
titleZhHans: 古典中国文学大作品二：从唐代到清代
titleZhHant: 古典中國文學大作品二：從唐代到清代
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在通过选取优秀作品，讨论其特征以及塑造其的思想，文化，社会背景，培养学生从唐代到清代的中国文学的先进知识。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在通過選取優秀作品，討論其特徵以及塑造其的思想，文化，社會背景，培養學生從唐代到清代的中國文學的先進知識。

descriptionEn: This course aims to foster among students a discovery-oriented attitude towards writing in expository Chinese whereby they can develop clear and critical thinking for devising appropriate strategies and making appropriate stylistic choices in a variety writing and editing tasks.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在培养学生对用简体中文写作的发现导向态度，以便他们能够形成明确和批判性的思维，制定适当的战略，并在各种写作和编辑任务中作出适当的风格选择。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在培養學生對用簡體中文寫作的發現導向態度，以便他們能夠形成明確和批判性的思維，制定適當的戰略，並在各種寫作和編輯任務中作出適當的風格選擇。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with training in making explicit rhetorical choices for purposes in a series of creative writing tasks.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在为学生提供在一系列创造性写作任务中作出明确的修辞选择的培训。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在爲學生提供在一系列創造性寫作任務中作出明確的修辭選擇的培訓。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with training in making explicit rhetorical choices for purposes in a series of creative writing tasks.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在为学生提供在一系列创造性写作任务中作出明确的修辞选择的培训。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在爲學生提供在一系列創造性寫作任務中作出明確的修辭選擇的培訓。

descriptionEn: This course aims to enhance students' professional knowledge and skills for mass media communication in the Chinese context.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在提高学生在中文背景下大众传媒传播的专业知识和技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在提高學生在中文背景下大衆傳媒傳播的專業知識和技能。

descriptionEn: This course aims to study every element of the publishing process from manuscript to book in print or digital form.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在研究出版过程的每个要素，从手稿到书籍的印刷或数字形式。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在研究出版過程的每個要素，從手稿到書籍的印刷或數字形式。

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce the history and development of Hong Kong literature from 1920 to the present time.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在介绍1920年至今香港文学的历史和发展。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在介紹1920年至今香港文學的歷史和發展。

descriptionEn: The objectives of this course are to impart to students basic knowledge and core concepts of contemporary Chinese literature, to initiate critical discussion of certain critical topics and phenomena that call students' attention to the particularities and development of contemporary Chinese literature, and to develop students' interest and ability in conducting original research in contemporary Chinese literature.
descriptionZhHans: 本课程的目标是向学生传授当代中国文学的基本知识和核心概念，开始批判性地讨论引起学生注意当代中国文学特点和发展的某些关键话题和现象，培养学生从事当代中国文学原创研究的兴趣和能力。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程的目標是向學生傳授當代中國文學的基本知識和核心概念，開始批判性地討論引起學生注意當代中國文學特點和發展的某些關鍵話題和現象，培養學生從事當代中國文學原創研究的興趣和能力。

descriptionEn: This course offers a comprehensive introduction to the study of cultures and heritages in Hong Kong as an interdisciplinary and cross-Area field of scholarly inquiry through which complex issues of material cultures, cultural preservations, business practices, and popular cultures can be critically analysed.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程全面介绍香港作为学科间和跨地区学术调查领域的文化与遗产研究，通过该课程可批判性地分析物质文化、文化保护、商业惯例和大众文化等复杂问题。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程全面介紹香港作爲學科間和跨地區學術調查領域的文化與遺產研究，通過該課程可批判性地分析物質文化、文化保護、商業慣例和大衆文化等複雜問題。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with a clear understanding of the nature and underlying principles of cultural tourism and the role it plays in cultural and heritage management.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生清楚地了解文化旅游的性质和基本原则及其在文化和遗产管理中的作用。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在讓學生清楚地瞭解文化旅遊的性質和基本原則及其在文化和遺產管理中的作用。

titleEn: History and Cultural Heritage of East Asia
descriptionEn: This course aims to provide a fundamental and comprehensive introduction to major cultural aspects and heritage of East Asia, with a thematic focus either on (a) Chinese culture and cultural heritage (including that of Hong Kong and Taiwan), or (b) Korean culture and cultural heritage (including that of Ancient Korean kingdoms and North Korea whenever necessary), or (c) Japanese culture and cultural heritage, depending on the availability of instructor.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在对东亚的主要文化方面和遗产进行基本和全面的介绍，专题重点要么是(a) 中国文化和文化遗产(包括香港和台湾的文化和文化遗产),要么是(b) 韩国文化和文化遗产(必要时包括古朝鲜王国和北朝鲜的文化和文化遗产),要么(c) 日本文化和文化遗产，视是否具备教员而定。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在對東亞的主要文化方面和遺產進行基本和全面的介紹，專題重點要麼是(a) 中國文化和文化遺產(包括香港和臺灣的文化和文化遺產),要麼是(b) 韓國文化和文化遺產(必要時包括古朝鮮王國和北朝鮮的文化和文化遺產),要麼(c) 日本文化和文化遺產，視是否具備教員而定。

descriptionEn: This course is an introduction to the history of the visual arts and culture in Western Europe from Antiquity to present.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程是西欧视觉艺术和文化史的介绍，从古代至今。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程是西歐視覺藝術和文化史的介紹，從古代至今。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with a fundamental knowledge of Lingnan's cultural traditions and heritage in such areas as painting, music, opera, drama, religion, architecture, horticulture, and cuisine, which have historical, aesthetic, archaeological, scientific, ethnological and/or anthropological value.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在为学生提供在绘画，音乐，歌剧，戏剧，宗教，建筑，园艺，美食等领域具有历史，美学，考古，科学，民族学和/或人类学价值的文化传统和遗产的基本知识。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在爲學生提供在繪畫，音樂，歌劇，戲劇，宗教，建築，園藝，美食等領域具有歷史，美學，考古，科學，民族學和/或人類學價值的文化傳統和遺產的基本知識。

descriptionEn: In modern societies "cultural identities" are always considered displayable.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 在现代社会中，"文化身份"总是被认为是可以展示的。
descriptionZhHant: 在現代社會中，"文化身份"總是被認爲是可以展示的。

descriptionEn: This course will introduce students to the fundamental knowledge of the history of patronage, the art market and the larger institutional network that supports and promotes art.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程将向学生介绍有关赞助历史、艺术市场和支持和促进艺术的较大机构网络的基本知识。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程將向學生介紹有關贊助歷史、藝術市場和支持和促進藝術的較大機構網絡的基本知識。

descriptionEn: The rapid development of the arts and cultural fields in Hong Kong and in the region will require well-trained professionals that can swiftly and efficiently respond to the needs of this evolving field.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 香港和本区域的艺术和文化领域的迅速发展将需要训练有素的专业人员，能够迅速有效地满足这一不断发展的领域的需求。
descriptionZhHant: 香港和本區域的藝術和文化領域的迅速發展將需要訓練有素的專業人員，能夠迅速有效地滿足這一不斷發展的領域的需求。

descriptionEn: The subjects of this course are archaeology and material culture.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 本课程的课题为考古学和材料文化。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程的課題爲考古學和材料文化。

descriptionEn: Museology has become one of the major cultural professions in the world.
descriptionZhHans: 博物馆学已成为世界主要文化专业之一。
descriptionZhHant: 博物館學已成爲世界主要文化專業之一。

descriptionEn: The course aims to introduce students to the theoretical, academic and professional skills required to design and manage artistic festivals and cultural events.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍设计和管理艺术节和文化活动所需的理论、学术和专业技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹設計和管理藝術節和文化活動所需的理論、學術和專業技能。

descriptionEn: This course aims to develop students' theoretical and contextual knowledge of critical approaches to the study of cultural heritage; Explore the historical and socio-political dimensions of heritage discourse in different national and cultural contexts Develop students' ability to critically reflect on and assess the implications of different interpretations and narratives of cultural heritage, national history, and cultural identity
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 文化遗产的批判性研究方法
titleZhHant: 文化遺產的批判性研究方法
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在培养学生对文化遗产研究的关键方法的理论和背景知识；探索不同民族和文化背景下遗产论述的历史和社会政治层面；培养学生批判性思考和评估对文化遗产、民族历史和文化认同的不同解释和叙述的影响的能力。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在培養學生對文化遺產研究的關鍵方法的理論和背景知識；探索不同民族和文化背景下遺產論述的歷史和社會政治層面；培養學生批判性思考和評估對文化遺產、民族歷史和文化認同的不同解釋和敘述的影響的能力。

descriptionEn: When writing an academic paper in Chinese on literature and history, students, as participants in academic debates, often ask questions, search for answers, organize ideas and supporting paragraphs, analyse the texts, and come to their own unique conclusions.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 学生在用中文写文学和历史的学术论文时，作为学术辩论的参与者，经常提出问题，寻找答案，组织思想和辅助段落，分析文字，得出自己独特的结论。
descriptionZhHant: 學生在用中文寫文學和歷史的學術論文時，作爲學術辯論的參與者，經常提出問題，尋找答案，組織思想和輔助段落，分析文字，得出自己獨特的結論。

descriptionEn: Siku Quanshu (Complete collection of the four treasuries), compiled in the Qianlong period of the Qing dynasty, was the largest collection of books and cultural project in Chinese history.
descriptionZhHans: 西库泉修(清朝乾隆年间编纂的四库全书),是中国历史上最大的藏书文化项目。
descriptionZhHant: 西庫泉修(清朝乾隆年間編纂的四庫全書),是中國歷史上最大的藏書文化項目。

descriptionEn: Dunhuang is an oasis lying at the crossroads where the northern and southern branches of the Silk Road meet.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 敦焕是位于丝绸之路南北分支交汇处的十字路口的绿洲。
descriptionZhHant: 敦煥是位於絲綢之路南北分支交匯處的十字路口的綠洲。

descriptionEn: This course addresses the contributions of archaeology to, and its interactions with, Chinese history.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 本课程探讨考古学对中国历史的贡献及其与中国历史的相互作用。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程探討考古學對中國歷史的貢獻及其與中國歷史的相互作用。

descriptionEn: This course introduces the basic concepts, theories and methods of archaeology, and provides a survey of archaeological excavations and discoveries around the world, including the Near East, Africa, China, Europe, and the Americas, with an emphasis on two or three regions.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程介绍了考古学的基本概念，理论和方法，并提供了包括近东，非洲，中国，欧洲，美洲在内的世界各地考古发掘和发现的调查，重点放在两三个地区。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程介紹了考古學的基本概念，理論和方法，並提供了包括近東，非洲，中國，歐洲，美洲在內的世界各地考古發掘和發現的調查，重點放在兩三個地區。

titleEn: Contemporary China from an Anthropological Perspective
descriptionEn: Drawing on a rich body of ethnographic and anthropological studies, this course provides a comprehensive introduction to contemporary China from perspectives that are not only social and cultural, but also historical and transnational.
titleZhHans: 从人类学角度看当代中国
titleZhHant: 從人類學角度看當代中國
descriptionZhHans: 该课程借鉴了丰富的人种学和人类学研究，从不仅社会和文化，而且历史和跨国的角度全面介绍了当代中国。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程借鑑了豐富的人種學和人類學研究，從不僅社會和文化，而且歷史和跨國的角度全面介紹了當代中國。

descriptionEn: This course explores the ethics, politics, and practices of oral history and, in general, fieldwork as an important research methodology.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 本课程探讨口述历史的伦理，政治，实践，并一般将实地工作作为重要的研究方法。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程探討口述歷史的倫理，政治，實踐，並一般將實地工作作爲重要的研究方法。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with an in-depth study of selected literary topic(s) from pre-Qin to contemporary Chinese literature.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在为学生提供从先秦到当代中国文学的选定文学题材的深入研究。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在爲學生提供從先秦到當代中國文學的選定文學題材的深入研究。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to enhance students' ability in discovering and analyzing Chinese classical literature by utilizing the important literary concepts in Chinese literary criticism.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是通过利用中国文学批评中的重要文学概念，增强学生发现和分析中国古典文学的能力。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是通過利用中國文學批評中的重要文學概念，增強學生髮現和分析中國古典文學的能力。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students embark on in-depth studies of selected great Chinese historical writing.
descriptionZhHans: 本课程旨在帮助学生开始深入学习部分优秀的中国历史著作。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程旨在幫助學生開始深入學習部分優秀的中國歷史著作。

titleEn: Selected Readings in Chinese Shi and Ci
descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with knowledge and exploration of classical Chinese Shi 詩 Ci 詞 poetry.
descriptionZhHans: 本课程旨在帮助学生认识并探索中国古典诗词。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程旨在幫助學生認識並探索中國古典詩詞。

descriptionEn: The aim is to students for Chinese teaching profession, and to help students to acquire the Chinese teaching and discovering ability in the tri-lingual and bi-literal settings of Hong Kong.
descriptionZhHans: 目的是让学生从事汉语教学专业，帮助学生在香港三语和双文的环境中获得汉语教学和发现能力。
descriptionZhHant: 目的是讓學生從事漢語教學專業，幫助學生在香港三語和雙文的環境中獲得漢語教學和發現能力。

descriptionEn: The aims of this course are as follows: to develop students' ability to analyze the basic tenets and history of Chinese Buddhism or Taoism. to enhance students' ability to discover and analyze the relationship between Chinese literature and Buddhism or Taoism. to develop students' ability to understand the significance of religious beliefs and appreciate the beauty of religious literature.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year

descriptionEn: This aim of the course is to allow students to: understand the states of matter through the ideal gas law and real gas equations of states, the kinetic theory and Boltzmann distribution of particles; describe the nature of and interactions between radiation and matter through elementary quantum theory; identify and comprehend the first and second and third laws of thermodynamics; apply the principles of introductory kinetics to analytical procedures in chemical reactions.â

descriptionEn: This course aims to: examine the nonelectrolytic solutions in terms of partial molar quantities; examine the electrolytic solutions in terms of conductances and ionic activities; describe the basic principles of electrochemistry and the application to chemical systems; describe the principles of kinetics, surface chemistry and macromolecules; extend the treatment of thermodynamics to chemical equilibria and phase equilibria; perform a deeper treatment of environmental chemistry in the areas of atmospheric chemistry and the interactions between liquids, solids and gases in aquatic chemistry.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在：从部分摩尔量的角度研究非电解溶液；从导电性和离子活性的角度研究电解溶液；描述电化学的基本原则和对化学系统的应用；描述动力学，表面化学和宏观分子的原理；将热力学的处理扩展到化学等离子体和相离子体；在大气化学领域以及水生化学中液体，固体和气体之间的相互作用方面进行更深层次的环境化学处理。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在：從部分摩爾量的角度研究非電解溶液；從導電性和離子活性的角度研究電解溶液；描述電化學的基本原則和對化學系統的應用；描述動力學，表面化學和宏觀分子的原理；將熱力學的處理擴展到化學等離子體和相離子體；在大氣化學領域以及水生化學中液體，固體和氣體之間的相互作用方面進行更深層次的環境化學處理。

descriptionZhHans: 在这一课程中，学生将：探索基因与其在分子、生物化学和生物层面的活动之间的关系，发展对一系列先进分子遗传技术和战略的理解，并将这些技术和战略应用于功能基因组研究，找出亲子基因和亲子基因/基因组之间的主要区别，各种基因调控机制设计适当的重组DNA实验，以解决具体的应用遗传问题，从而学习如何在最后一年项目中克隆和描述基因(CHEM4036).

titleEn: Chemical Biology of DNA and RNA
descriptionEn: In this course, students will be able to: i) develop an understanding of a wide range of advanced chemical biology techniques, and their application to the study of nucleic acid structure and function studies ii) devise appropriate chemical biology experiments to address specific basic and applied bioscience problems related to nucleic acids iii) explore the relationship between nucleic acids and their chemical and biochemical properties iv) identify the major differences between deoxyribonucleic acids (DNA) and ribonucleic acids (RNA), and the diverse targeting strategies

descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探索和欣赏不同英文文本的风格，以便让他们在基础概念和语法术语中找到基础，从而能够分析文本的语气特征并发展他们的英文写作技能，特别是用于翻译目的。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探索和欣賞不同英文文本的風格，以便讓他們在基礎概念和語法術語中找到基礎，從而能夠分析文本的語氣特徵並發展他們的英文寫作技能，特別是用於翻譯目的。

descriptionEn: The course aims to help students explore and develop a critical awareness of the stylistic features and conventional usage of selected practical text types of writing, such as advertising, news-media and literary text types, with a view to enhancing their ability to (1) apply general stylistic concepts to the analysis of specific practical text types and (2) manipulate the conventions of the text types in question.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探索并培养对特定实用文字类型，如广告，新闻媒介和文学文字类型等某些实用文字类型的形式特征和常规使用的批判性认识，以提高他们(1)应用一般的风格概念分析具体实用文字类型的能力，(2)操纵相关文字类型的常规。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探索並培養對特定實用文字類型，如廣告，新聞媒介和文學文字類型等某些實用文字類型的形式特徵和常規使用的批判性認識，以提高他們(1)應用一般的風格概念分析具體實用文字類型的能力，(2)操縱相關文字類型的常規。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students explore and understand a variety of human experience as expressed in literary works and to equip them with the linguistic and critical skills for comparing and analysing similarities and differences in literary works of different cultures, with a view to developing their reading and writing skills for their respective disciplines.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探索和理解文学作品中表达的各种人类经验，并使他们掌握语言和批判技能，以比较和分析不同文化文学作品中的相似之处和差异，以期为各自的学科培养他们的阅读和写作技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探索和理解文學作品中表達的各種人類經驗，並使他們掌握語言和批判技能，以比較和分析不同文化文學作品中的相似之處和差異，以期爲各自的學科培養他們的閱讀和寫作技能。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students explore cross-cultural understanding of self and other, and China and the world with a view to developing their knowledge and understanding of the multifaceted issues involved in cultural translation.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探索对自我和其他以及中国和世界的跨文化理解，以培养他们对文化翻译所涉多方面问题的知识和了解。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探索對自我和其他以及中國和世界的跨文化理解，以培養他們對文化翻譯所涉多方面問題的知識和了解。

descriptionEn: This is a theme-based course that introduces the basic concepts, issues, and techniques of translation and its related activities such as editing and proofreading.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 这是一个基于主题的课程，介绍翻译的基本概念、问题和技术及其相关活动，如编辑和校对。
descriptionZhHant: 這是一個基於主題的課程，介紹翻譯的基本概念、問題和技術及其相關活動，如編輯和校對。

descriptionEn: The primary aim of this course is to foster a discovery-oriented attitude among students, exposing them to the profession of interpretation, build up their bilingual and organizational skills and short-term memory, equip them with the basic techniques for interpretation, and train them to perform a variety of situational interpretation tasks.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的主要目的是培养学生以发现为导向的态度，让他们接触口译专业，培养他们的双语和组织技能及短期记忆，使他们掌握基本的口译技术，并培训他们执行各种情况解读任务。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的主要目的是培養學生以發現爲導向的態度，讓他們接觸口譯專業，培養他們的雙語和組織技能及短期記憶，使他們掌握基本的口譯技術，並培訓他們執行各種情況解讀任務。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students explore the essential differences in the two common modes of interpretation, namely, consecutive and simultaneous, and to strengthen their linguistic skills, broaden their world knowledge, develop their skills for consecutive interpretation, and equip them with the basic skills for simultaneous interpretation.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探索两种共同口译模式(即连续和同时口译)中的基本差异，并加强他们的语言技能，拓宽他们的世界知识，发展他们的连续口译技能，并使他们具备同声传译的基本技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探索兩種共同口譯模式(即連續和同時口譯)中的基本差異，並加強他們的語言技能，拓寬他們的世界知識，發展他們的連續口譯技能，並使他們具備同聲傳譯的基本技能。

descriptionEn: This course is an introductory course of Japanese Linguistics.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 本课程是日本语言学的入门课程。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程是日本語言學的入門課程。

descriptionEn: The internship is designed to enable students to discover for themselves real life working experience in local and/or international contexts for a period of time.
descriptionZhHans: 实习的目的是让学生能够在当地和(或)国际背景下在一段时间内为自己发现实际工作经验。
descriptionZhHant: 實習的目的是讓學生能夠在當地和(或)國際背景下在一段時間內爲自己發現實際工作經驗。

descriptionEn: This course aims at enabling students to apply modern morphology and syntax frameworks to the analysis of language data and discover and formulate hypotheses that are observationally, descriptively and explanatorily adequate.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在使学生能够应用现代形态学和语法框架来分析语言数据，并发现和提出从观察、描述和解释上都适当的假设。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在使學生能夠應用現代形態學和語法框架來分析語言數據，並發現和提出從觀察、描述和解釋上都適當的假設。

descriptionEn: This course aims to use mark-up languages for electronic publishing and database modelling; introduce students to the basic concepts of WWW and features of Web 2.0; introduce students to the basic concepts of linguistic phenomenon of the use of language in the contexts of computer -mediated communication; enable students to analyse language data in the contexts of electronic publishing
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在使用标记语言进行电子出版和数据库建模；向学生介绍WWW的基本概念和Web 2.0的特征；向学生介绍计算机-媒介通信中使用语言的语言现象的基本概念；使学生能够分析电子出版背景下的语言数据。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在使用標記語言進行電子出版和數據庫建模；向學生介紹WWW的基本概念和Web 2.0的特徵；向學生介紹計算機-媒介通信中使用語言的語言現象的基本概念；使學生能夠分析電子出版背景下的語言數據。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to examine aspects of linguistic meaning and language use.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是审查语言含义和语言使用的各个方面。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是審查語言含義和語言使用的各個方面。

descriptionEn: The course aims to introduce to students: (i) the basic concepts of phonetics, (ii) the articulatory and prosodic properties of human speech sounds, (iii) the International Phonetic Alphabet (or the IPA symbols) for transcribing speech sounds, and (iv) the phonetic characteristics of English and Chinese.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍：(一) 语音学的基本概念，(二) 人类语音的动词和流派特性，(三) 国际语音字母表(或IPA符号)用于转写语音，(四) 英语和汉语的语音特征。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹：(一) 語音學的基本概念，(二) 人類語音的動詞和流派特性，(三) 國際語音字母表(或IPA符號)用於轉寫語音，(四) 英語和漢語的語音特徵。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to examine how textual constituents are related and organized in speech and writing.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是审查文字成分如何相互联系，如何用言语和文字组织起来。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是審查文字成分如何相互聯繫，如何用言語和文字組織起來。

descriptionEn: The course aims to introduce to students the knowledge of phonology and methods of phonological analysis of phonetic data and formulating phonological rules for discovering sound patterns of languages.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍有关语音学的知识以及对语音数据进行声学分析的方法，以及制定用于发现语言声音规律的声学规则。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹有關語音學的知識以及對語音數據進行聲學分析的方法，以及制定用於發現語言聲音規律的聲學規則。

descriptionEn: Pragmatics investigates the role of context in the interpretation of meaning.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 实用论调查上下文在解释意义中的作用。
descriptionZhHant: 實用論調查上下文在解釋意義中的作用。

descriptionEn: This course serves as a general introduction to the history and grammar of Chinese languages, with special focus on Mandarin and Cantonese.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程作为汉语语言历史和语法的概括介绍，特别以普通话和广东话为主。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程作爲漢語語言歷史和語法的概括介紹，特別以普通話和廣東話爲主。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to introduce students to basic principles and technologies for formatting documents and publishing them electronically, especially on the Web.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是向学生介绍文件格式化和以电子方式出版，特别是在网上出版文件的基本原则和技术。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是向學生介紹文件格式化和以電子方式出版，特別是在網上出版文件的基本原則和技術。

descriptionEn: The main aim of this course is to introduce the basic concepts, principles and methodologies in corpus linguistics, with an emphasis on the construction and use of organic collections of texts for linguistic knowledge and practical applications, particularly in relation to the basic understanding of large language models.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的主要目的是介绍本体语言学的基本概念、原则和方法，重点是为语言知识和实际应用，特别是就对大语言模式的基本理解而言，构建和使用各种文本的有机集。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的主要目的是介紹本體語言學的基本概念、原則和方法，重點是爲語言知識和實際應用，特別是就對大語言模式的基本理解而言，構建和使用各種文本的有機集。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to study the roles of computers and information technology, linguistic knowledge and translation expertise in the automation of translation and examine the possibilities of integrating the best of human and machine intelligence to maximize translation productivity.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是研究计算机和信息技术、语言知识和翻译专门知识在翻译自动化方面的作用，并研究将最好的人力和机器智能结合起来以最大限度地提高翻译生产率的可能性。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是研究計算機和信息技術、語言知識和翻譯專門知識在翻譯自動化方面的作用，並研究將最好的人力和機器智能結合起來以最大限度地提高翻譯生產率的可能性。

descriptionEn: This course aims at introducing the theoretical and practical issues in dictionary making, with particular focus on the opportunities and benefits which computers have to offer in the process.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在介绍词典制作中的理论和实践问题，特别侧重于计算机在这一过程中必须提供的机会和好处。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在介紹詞典制作中的理論和實踐問題，特別側重於計算機在這一過程中必須提供的機會和好處。

descriptionEn: This course aims at introducing students to some of the major issues, solutions and difficulties in Chinese language processing.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍汉语语言处理中的一些重大问题，解决方案和困难。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹漢語語言處理中的一些重大問題，解決方案和困難。

descriptionEn: This course aims to develop students’ understanding of the hardware and software resources of a computer system, and to develop students’ use of these resources to solve linguistic computing problems.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在培养学生对计算机系统硬件和软件资源的理解，并发展学生利用这些资源解决语言计算问题。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在培養學生對計算機系統硬件和軟件資源的理解，並發展學生利用這些資源解決語言計算問題。

descriptionEn: This course aims at introducing students to some of the major issues and solutions in natural language processing.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍自然语言处理中的一些主要问题和解决方案。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹自然語言處理中的一些主要問題和解決方案。

descriptionEn: In this course, students in the areas of humanities and social sciences will be introduced to the study of language from the perspective of human cognition and its impact on language production and language use.
descriptionZhHans: 在这个课程中，将引导人文和社会科学领域的学生从人类认知的角度及其对语言制作和语言使用的影响来研究语言。
descriptionZhHant: 在這個課程中，將引導人文和社會科學領域的學生從人類認知的角度及其對語言製作和語言使用的影響來研究語言。

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce students to quantitative research paradigms and common experimental methods in language studies.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍语言研究中的定量研究范式和常见的实验方法。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹語言研究中的定量研究範式和常見的實驗方法。

descriptionEn: This course aims to give students with no previous knowledge of the language an introduction to the grammar and vocabulary of ancient Greek, with an emphasis on reading proficiency.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向以前没有语言知识的学生介绍古希腊语的语法和词汇，强调阅读能力。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向以前沒有語言知識的學生介紹古希臘語的語法和詞彙，強調閱讀能力。

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce the basic concepts and analytical techniques in the study of language from a comparative and contrastive perspective.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在从比较和对比的角度在语言研究中引入基本概念和分析技术。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在從比較和對比的角度在語言研究中引入基本概念和分析技術。

descriptionEn: The internship is designed to provide students with real life working experience in local and/or international contexts for a period of time.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 实习旨在为学生提供当地和(或)国际环境下一段时间的实际工作经验。
descriptionZhHant: 實習旨在爲學生提供當地和(或)國際環境下一段時間的實際工作經驗。

descriptionEn: This course aims to empower students to critically study selected writings by authors famous and anonymous published bilingually on a range of identical topics, and to discover the ways in which the discourse features of such literature may inform the practice of translation.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在授权学生批判性地研究著名和匿名作者就一系列相同专题发表的双语著作，并发现这些文献的论述特征如何为翻译实践提供参考。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在授權學生批判性地研究著名和匿名作者就一系列相同專題發表的雙語著作，並發現這些文獻的論述特徵如何爲翻譯實踐提供參考。

titleEn: Comparative Study of Chinese and English
descriptionEn: This course aims to sensitize students to the discovery of fundamental linguistic differences between Chinese and English with a view to enabling them to communicate efficiently and creatively between the two languages by way of a comparative account of how the two languages organize and express meaning in verbal and written discourse through their respective grammatical structures and stylistic devices.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在提高学生对发现汉语和英语之间基本语言差异的认识，以便他们能够通过比较说明两种语言如何通过各自的语法结构和语法手段，在口头和书面话语中组织和表达意义，从而高效和创造性地沟通两种语言。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在提高學生對發現漢語和英語之間基本語言差異的認識，以便他們能夠通過比較說明兩種語言如何通過各自的語法結構和語法手段，在口頭和書面話語中組織和表達意義，從而高效和創造性地溝通兩種語言。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students explore the craft and art of good writing through fostering and developing a self-motivated interest in writing.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在通过培养和培养自发的写作兴趣，帮助学生探索好写作的工艺和艺术。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在通過培養和培養自發的寫作興趣，幫助學生探索好寫作的工藝和藝術。

descriptionEn: The course aims to provide an intermediate-level training in translation from Chinese into English, with a view to strengthening students’ ability to translate more accurately and appropriately.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在提供中文译成英文的中级培训，以期加强学生更准确和适当翻译的能力。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在提供中文譯成英文的中級培訓，以期加強學生更準確和適當翻譯的能力。

descriptionEn: This course aims to sharpen students’ comprehension ability in English and their translation skills through vigorous translation exercises of different text-types in English.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在通过大力进行不同英文文本类型的翻译工作，提高学生的英语理解能力及其翻译技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在通過大力進行不同英文文本類型的翻譯工作，提高學生的英語理解能力及其翻譯技能。

descriptionEn: Any discipline of knowledge is built upon the relationships between concepts and terms.
descriptionZhHans: 任何知识学科都建立在概念和术语之间的关系上。
descriptionZhHant: 任何知識學科都建立在概念和術語之間的關係上。

descriptionEn: Bilingual editing is a kind of editing undertaken in a bilingual mode.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 双语编辑是一种以双语方式进行的编辑。
descriptionZhHant: 雙語編輯是一種以雙語方式進行的編輯。

descriptionEn: The course aims to lay the foundations for, and to enable students to identify, evaluate and formulate the practice of, commercial translation by studying and working with authentic bilingual commercial documents from the business sector of Hong Kong.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在为商业翻译奠定基础，并使学生能够通过研究香港商业界的双语商业文件并与之合作，确定、评价和制定商业翻译的做法。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在爲商業翻譯奠定基礎，並使學生能夠通過研究香港商業界的雙語商業文件並與之合作，確定、評價和制定商業翻譯的做法。

titleEn: Translation for Government and Public Administration
descriptionEn: This course aims to acquaint students with the knowledge and skills in translation and bilingual communication required for a career in government and public administration.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 为政府和公共行政翻译
titleZhHant: 爲政府和公共行政翻譯

descriptionZhHant: 這是一個更高級的心理語言學課程。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to apply the knowledge of semantics and pragmatics to Japanese language.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是将语义学和实用学的知识应用于日语。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是將語義學和實用學的知識應用於日語。

descriptionEn: This course takes a cognitive approach to the study of reading comprehension.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程采用认知方法研究阅读理解。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程採用認知方法研究閱讀理解。

descriptionEn: This course aims to let students have a clear understanding of how languages are learned and processed from the psychological perspective.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生从心理角度清楚了解语言的学习和处理方式。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在讓學生從心理角度清楚瞭解語言的學習和處理方式。

descriptionEn: With the use of new behavioural and brain imaging techniques, many new insights into the cognitive and neural processes underlying language comprehension and production have been established.
titleZhHans: 神经语言学和精神语言学专题
titleZhHant: 神經語言學和精神語言學專題
descriptionZhHans: 随着新的行为和大脑成像技术的运用，对语言理解和制作所基于的认知和神经过程有了许多新的见解。
descriptionZhHant: 隨着新的行爲和大腦成像技術的運用，對語言理解和製作所基於的認知和神經過程有了許多新的見解。

descriptionEn: This course introduces the study of language change, discusses the different ways in which languages can and do change.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程引入了语言变化的研究，讨论了语言能够和能够实现变化的不同方式。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程引入了語言變化的研究，討論了語言能夠和能夠實現變化的不同方式。

descriptionEn: Audiovisual Translation is an exciting new field in Translation Studies for which there is a growing professional demand, and the need for professionals in this field has grown exponentially with the advent of cable television and digitalisation.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 视听翻译是翻译研究中一个令人振奋的新领域，这方面的专业需求日益增长，随着有线电视和数字化的出现，这一领域的专业人员的需求成倍增长。
descriptionZhHant: 視聽翻譯是翻譯研究中一個令人振奮的新領域，這方面的專業需求日益增長，隨着有線電視和數字化的出現，這一領域的專業人員的需求成倍增長。

descriptionEn: The overall aim of the course is to provide students with a firm grounding in the theory and practice of translation for live performance.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 课程的总目标是为学生提供翻译理论和实践的坚实基础，以进行现场表演。
descriptionZhHant: 課程的總目標是爲學生提供翻譯理論和實踐的堅實基礎，以進行現場表演。

titleEn: Globalization and the History of Translation
descriptionEn: This course aims to expose students to the history of translation around the world, and in so doing help them explore, understand and appreciate the important issues involved and changes in translation norms and the relationship between those norms and the larger forces of world history.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生了解世界各地的翻译史，从而帮助他们探索、理解和理解涉及的重要问题和翻译规范的变化，以及这些规范与世界历史更大力量之间的关系。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在讓學生了解世界各地的翻譯史，從而幫助他們探索、理解和理解涉及的重要問題和翻譯規範的變化，以及這些規範與世界歷史更大力量之間的關係。

titleEn: Specialized Translation in Commerce and Finance
descriptionEn: Based on the foundation laid in the prerequisite course LT3347 Commercial Translation, this course further enables students to explore the skills and knowledge in translating business documents, with special emphasis on the translation of financial documents.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 基于LT3347商业翻译必修课程的基础，该课程进一步使学生能够探索翻译商业文件的技能和知识，特别强调财务文件的翻译。
descriptionZhHant: 基於LT3347商業翻譯必修課程的基礎，該課程進一步使學生能夠探索翻譯商業文件的技能和知識，特別強調財務文件的翻譯。

descriptionEn: The course further develops students’ ability to translate more difficult texts for legal purposes by (1) sensitizing them to the subtle linguistic, cultural and legal issues involved; (2) stimulating them to explore for solutions to the multi-faceted problems confronting them: and (3) developing professionalism in performing a variety of tasks in legal settings.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程进一步发展了学生为法律目的翻译更困难的文本的能力，方法是：(1) 使他们认识到所涉及的微妙的语言、文化和法律问题；(2) 激励他们探索如何解决他们面临的多方面问题；(3) 在法律环境中执行各种任务时培养专业精神。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程進一步發展了學生爲法律目的翻譯更困難的文本的能力，方法是：(1) 使他們認識到所涉及的微妙的語言、文化和法律問題；(2) 激勵他們探索如何解決他們面臨的多方面問題；(3) 在法律環境中執行各種任務時培養專業精神。

titleEn: Specialized Translation for Government and Public Administration
descriptionEn: This course, building on the foundations laid in LT3348, aims to enable students to achieve sharpened linguistic and critical skills through translation practice and the critique of translation in order that they may pursue a career in the bilingual civil service of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 政府和公共行政专业翻译
titleZhHant: 政府和公共行政專業翻譯
descriptionZhHans: 该课程建立在LT3348奠定的基础之上，旨在通过翻译实践和对翻译的批评，使学生能够提高语言和关键技能，从而在香港特别行政区政府的双语公务员队伍中谋求事业。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程建立在LT3348奠定的基礎之上，旨在通過翻譯實踐和對翻譯的批評，使學生能夠提高語言和關鍵技能，從而在香港特別行政區政府的雙語公務員隊伍中謀求事業。

descriptionEn: As an advanced course on translation for the media, this course specializes in the translation of media texts from English to Chinese and from Chinese into English, especially in the Hong Kong context.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 作为媒体翻译的高级课程，该课程专门将媒体文本从英文翻译成中文，从中文翻译成英文，特别是在香港。
descriptionZhHant: 作爲媒體翻譯的高級課程，該課程專門將媒體文本從英文翻譯成中文，從中文翻譯成英文，特別是在香港。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students explore, understand and appreciate the subtleties and complexities of sophisticated Chinese and English literary texts through close readings of selected works on the one hand, and develop their ability to tackle the theoretical issues involved and devise appropriate strategies in translation on the other.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探索、理解和理解精密的中文和英文文学文本的微妙性和复杂性，一方面通过对部分作品的密切阅读，另一方面发展他们处理所涉理论问题的能力，并制定翻译方面的适当战略。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探索、理解和理解精密的中文和英文文學文本的微妙性和複雜性，一方面通過對部分作品的密切閱讀，另一方面發展他們處理所涉理論問題的能力，並制定翻譯方面的適當戰略。

titleEn: Specialized Translation of Science and Technology
descriptionEn: This course has two aims: to introduce students to the most recent and cutting-edge developments in science studies with a focus on translation and to develop students' ability to solve basic problems in translating scientific and technical materials.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程有两个目的：向学生介绍科学研究的最新和尖端发展，重点是翻译，并培养学生解决翻译科学技术材料的基本问题的能力。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程有兩個目的：向學生介紹科學研究的最新和尖端發展，重點是翻譯，並培養學生解決翻譯科學技術材料的基本問題的能力。

titleEn: Discovering Critical Interfaces between Translation Theory and Practice
descriptionEn: The aim of this course is first of all to organize and consolidate students’ knowledge of translation studies and its development as an academic discipline in both Chinese and other traditions with special reference to communication and language use in cross-cultural contexts.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 发现翻译理论与实践之间的关键界面
titleZhHant: 發現翻譯理論與實踐之間的關鍵界面
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的首先是组织和巩固学生对翻译研究的知识，并将其发展成为中国传统和其他传统中的学术学科，特别在跨文化背景下的交流和语言使用。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的首先是組織和鞏固學生對翻譯研究的知識，並將其發展成爲中國傳統和其他傳統中的學術學科，特別在跨文化背景下的交流和語言使用。

descriptionEn: The course aims to consolidate the skills and techniques which students have acquired in previous semesters in order that they may be able to pursue a career in interpreting involving English and Chinese.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 高级连续解释(英文-中文)
titleZhHant: 高級連續解釋(英文-中文)
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在巩固学生在前几学期获得的技能和技术，以便他们能够从事涉及英语和汉语的口译工作。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在鞏固學生在前幾學期獲得的技能和技術，以便他們能夠從事涉及英語和漢語的口譯工作。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with intensive and rigorous training in simultaneous interpretation (SI) with a view to enabling them to perform the task with enhanced competence in more demanding situations.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 高级同声传译(英文-中文)
titleZhHant: 高級同聲傳譯(英文-中文)
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生提供同声传译(SI)的强化和严格培训，使他们能够在更困难的情况下以更强的能力完成任务。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生提供同聲傳譯(SI)的強化和嚴格培訓，使他們能夠在更困難的情況下以更強的能力完成任務。

descriptionEn: This course aims to acquaint students with the core of modern translation theory, from simpler to more sophisticated concepts and principles, and from practical and empirical to more theoretical approaches to the translator's work.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生熟悉现代翻译理论的核心，从更简单到更精密的概念和原则，从实用和实证方法到更理论的方法到翻译者的工作。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在讓學生熟悉現代翻譯理論的核心，從更簡單到更精密的概念和原則，從實用和實證方法到更理論的方法到翻譯者的工作。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to give students the experience of producing an extended translation up to academic or professional standards, or of producing an extended research paper on some topic of importance in translation or linguistic studies.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是向学生提供制作符合学术或专业标准的扩展译文的经验，或就翻译或语言研究中某些重要专题编写扩展研究论文的经验。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是向學生提供製作符合學術或專業標準的擴展譯文的經驗，或就翻譯或語言研究中某些重要專題編寫擴展研究論文的經驗。

titleEn: Topics in Korean Language and Linguistics
descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with an in-depth study of selected topics within the area of Korean language and linguistics, covering both theoretical and applied linguistics such as phonetics, phonology, syntax, first and second language acquisition, and language pedagogy.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生提供韩国语言和语言学领域所选专题的深入研究，涵盖理论和应用语言学，如语音学，声学，语法，第一语言和第二语言的获取，以及语言教学法。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生提供韓國語言和語言學領域所選專題的深入研究，涵蓋理論和應用語言學，如語音學，聲學，語法，第一語言和第二語言的獲取，以及語言教學法。

descriptionEn: The internship aims to enable students to apply the knowledge and skills acquired in the professional workplaces and discover for themselves real-life working experience in local, regional, and/or global contexts.
descriptionZhHans: 实习旨在使学生能够应用专业工作场所获得的知识和技能，并在当地、区域和(或)全球范围内为自己发现实际工作经验。
descriptionZhHant: 實習旨在使學生能夠應用專業工作場所獲得的知識和技能，並在當地、區域和(或)全球範圍內爲自己發現實際工作經驗。

descriptionEn: This course covers two areas of the study of sounds of languages, phonetics and phonology, and their interrelationship.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程涵盖语言、语音和音响及其相互关系两个研究领域。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程涵蓋語言、語音和音響及其相互關係兩個研究領域。

descriptionEn: The course aims to expose students to morphological and syntactic structures of natural language.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生接触自然语言的形态和合成结构。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在讓學生接觸自然語言的形態和合成結構。

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce students to the study of meaning as it is realized at both the lexico-grammatical and discourse levels.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍在语法-语法和论述层面实现的意义的研究。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹在語法-語法和論述層面實現的意義的研究。

descriptionEn: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the psychological and cognitive foundations of language acquisition, comprehension, and production.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程全面介绍语言获取、理解和制作的心理和认知基础。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程全面介紹語言獲取、理解和製作的心理和認知基礎。

descriptionEn: The aim of this course is to familiarize students with the basic concepts, methodology measurement techniques and statistical methods in applied linguistics second language acquisition and sociolinguistics.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程的目的是让学生熟悉应用语言学第二语言学和社会语言学的基本概念、方法测量技术和统计方法。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程的目的是讓學生熟悉應用語言學第二語言學和社會語言學的基本概念、方法測量技術和統計方法。

descriptionEn: This course aims to address issues related to the subfield of linguistics that is concerned with how social factors interact with language.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在解决与语言学亚领域有关的问题，涉及社会因素如何与语言相互作用。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在解決與語言學亞領域有關的問題，涉及社會因素如何與語言相互作用。

descriptionEn: This course aims to: Emphasize that function and semantics are the basis of human language and communicative activity Study language as a system operating in and being influenced by social context; Enable students to generate innovative linguistic analysis using concepts developed in systemic functional linguistics.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在：强调功能和语义是人类语言和交流活动的基础 研究语言作为一个在社会环境中运作并受其影响的系统；使学生能够利用在系统功能语言学中形成的概念产生创新的语言分析。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在：強調功能和語義是人類語言和交流活動的基礎 研究語言作爲一個在社會環境中運作並受其影響的系統；使學生能夠利用在系統功能語言學中形成的概念產生創新的語言分析。

descriptionEn: This course aims at introducing students with various academic backgrounds to the quantitative aspects of language and the basic concepts of the application of computational techniques in language processing.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向具有不同学术背景的学生介绍语言的定量方面和在语言处理中应用计算技术的基本概念。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向具有不同學術背景的學生介紹語言的定量方面和在語言處理中應用計算技術的基本概念。

descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce the students to major aspects of English language teaching, and to provide them with a framework in which they can apply various linguistic theories to different levels of teaching English as a second/foreign language (TESL/TEFL) so as to develop effective and innovative language pedagogy.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生介绍英语教学的主要方面，并为他们提供一个框架，使他们能够将各种语言理论应用到不同层次的英语教学中，作为第二/外语(TESL/TEFL),以便发展有效和创新的语言教学法。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在向學生介紹英語教學的主要方面，併爲他們提供一個框架，使他們能夠將各種語言理論應用到不同層次的英語教學中，作爲第二/外語(TESL/TEFL),以便發展有效和創新的語言教學法。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students explore the multifaceted problems in the part of the philosophy of language which is closely related to their study with a view to broadening their intellectual horizons, deepening their understanding of language, sharpening their awareness of human cognition, and reinforcing their analytical and critical skills for tackling theoretical issues in their respective disciplines from the philosophical perspective.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在帮助学生探讨语言哲学中与其研究密切相关的多方面问题，以期拓宽其智力视野，加深对语言的理解，提高他们对人类认知的认识，并加强他们从哲学角度处理各自学科理论问题的分析和关键技能。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在幫助學生探討語言哲學中與其研究密切相關的多方面問題，以期拓寬其智力視野，加深對語言的理解，提高他們對人類認知的認識，並加強他們從哲學角度處理各自學科理論問題的分析和關鍵技能。

descriptionEn: This course introduces grammaticalization, one of the important approaches to historical linguistics, to graduate students.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 本课程向研究生介绍语法化，这是历史语言学的重要方法之一。
descriptionZhHant: 本課程向研究生介紹語法化，這是歷史語言學的重要方法之一。

descriptionEn: This course aims at introducing to typology and language universals, the domain of linguistics which investigates language properties that cannot be discovered by observing a single language alone but rather by conducting a general survey of languages in the world.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
titleZhHans: 语言世界论和语言类型学
titleZhHant: 語言世界論和語言類型學
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在介绍类型学和语言普世论，即语言学领域，它通过单独观察单一语言来调查无法发现的语言特性，而是对世界语言进行一般性调查。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在介紹類型學和語言普世論，即語言學領域，它通過單獨觀察單一語言來調查無法發現的語言特性，而是對世界語言進行一般性調查。

titleEn: Second Language Pronunciation Acquisition: from Theory to Practice
descriptionEn: This course aims to introduce and discuss major issues in the area of second language speech learning including speech production and perception, along with techniques for incorporating research into practical classroom instruction on pronunciation.
titleZhHans: 第二语言读音 获取：从理论到实践
titleZhHant: 第二語言讀音 獲取：從理論到實踐
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在介绍和讨论第二语言语音学习领域的主要问题，包括语音的制作和感知，以及将研究纳入关于读音的课堂实际教学的技术。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在介紹和討論第二語言語音學習領域的主要問題，包括語音的製作和感知，以及將研究納入關於讀音的課堂實際教學的技術。

descriptionEn: This course aims to develop students' understanding and critical analysis of different genres of literature from the perspective of language arts.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在从语言艺术的角度培养学生对不同文学流派的理解和批判性分析。

descriptionEn: This course aims to acquaint the student with some major theories of law which have significantly influenced or criticised the conceptual development of law, and to examine historical evolution of law; natural law theory; legal positivism; law and society movement; legal realism; theories of justice; law and morality; the nature of rights; and the rule of law, as well as reflecting in a disciplined and critical manner on the nature and role of law and legal institutions.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生熟悉一些对法律概念发展有重大影响或批评的重大法律理论，并审查法律的历史演变；自然法理论；法律实体主义；法律和社会运动；法律现实主义；正义理论；法律和道德；权利性质；法治，以及纪律和批判性地反映法律和法律机构的性质和作用。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程旨在讓學生熟悉一些對法律概念發展有重大影響或批評的重大法律理論，並審查法律的歷史演變；自然法理論；法律實體主義；法律和社會運動；法律現實主義；正義理論；法律和道德；權利性質；法治，以及紀律和批判性地反映法律和法律機構的性質和作用。

titleEn: Law of Human Rights and Civil Liberties of Hong Kong
descriptionEn: This course prepares students to evaluate the legitimacy of government power and actions and their impact upon fundamental human rights and civil liberties- and to discover the doctrine of separation of powers, the relationship between state and individual and the role of the courts and the legislature in defining and controlling the power of the administration.
titleZhHans: 香港人权和公民自由法
titleZhHant: 香港人權和公民自由法
descriptionZhHans: 该课程培养学生评价政府权力和行动的合法性及其对基本人权和公民自由的影响，并发现三权分立的理论、国家与个人之间的关系以及法院和立法机构在确定和控制行政部门权力方面的作用。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程培養學生評價政府權力和行動的合法性及其對基本人權和公民自由的影響，並發現三權分立的理論、國家與個人之間的關係以及法院和立法機構在確定和控制行政部門權力方面的作用。

descriptionEn: The course aims to teach students rules and principles of environmental law, which is the body of law incorporating common law doctrines and legislative enactments in pollution control and conservation of natural resources.
offeringTerm: Not offering in current academic year
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在向学生教授环境法的规则和原则，这是纳入普通法理论和关于污染控制和自然资源保护的立法的一整套法律。

descriptionEn: This course - examines the nature, scope and significance of equity and trusts. develops a sound knowledge of the principles of equity and trusts. develops: research skills analytical and problem-solving skills effective written and oral communication skills in relation to issues in trusts law develops an awareness of the social and commercial contexts in which trust law operates. introduces students to some of the basic practical skills required to advise on applying trust law.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程 -- -- 研究公平和信托的性质、范围和意义；发展对公平和信托原则的正确了解；发展：研究技能分析和解决问题的技能；与信托法中的问题有关的有效书面和口头交流技能；提高对信托法运作的社会和商业背景的认识；向学生介绍一些必要的基本实用技能，以便就适用信托法提供咨询意见。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程 -- -- 研究公平和信託的性質、範圍和意義；發展對公平和信託原則的正確瞭解；發展：研究技能分析和解決問題的技能；與信託法中的問題有關的有效書面和口頭交流技能；提高對信託法運作的社會和商業背景的認識；向學生介紹一些必要的基本實用技能，以便就適用信託法提供諮詢意見。

descriptionEn: This course deals with topics concerning trusts that arise out of the operation of law as opposed to those express trusts being taught in Semester A.

descriptionZhHant: 該課程涉及的是與Semester A教授的明示信託相反的法律運作所產生的信託問題。

descriptionEn: Criminology is an inter-disciplinary field that draws on a number of different academic traditions - including law, psychology, economics, anthropology, psychiatry, sociology biology and statistics - to explain the causes and prevalence of criminal behaviour, and to propose appropriate preventative, punitive and rehabilitative measures in dealing with crime, the communities in which crimes take place, and its convicted offenders.
descriptionZhHans: 犯罪学是一个跨学科领域，它利用一些不同的学术传统，包括法律、心理学、经济学、人类学、精神病学、社会学生物学和统计，解释犯罪行为的原因和普遍程度，并提出适当的预防、惩罚和改造措施来处理犯罪、犯罪发生地社区及其定罪罪犯。
descriptionZhHant: 犯罪學是一個跨學科領域，它利用一些不同的學術傳統，包括法律、心理學、經濟學、人類學、精神病學、社會學生物學和統計，解釋犯罪行爲的原因和普遍程度，並提出適當的預防、懲罰和改造措施來處理犯罪、犯罪發生地社區及其定罪罪犯。

descriptionEn: This course aims to provide students with an understanding and appreciation of the main features of the Criminal Justice system in Hong Kong; its mode of operation, the interaction between its principal agents, institutions and practices, and the theoretical foundations underpinning those bodies and processes.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程旨在让学生了解和理解香港刑事司法制度的主要特点、其运作方式、其主要代理人、机构和做法之间的互动以及支撑这些机构和程序的理论基础。

descriptionEn: This course aims to help students understand the game design / development process, how to prepare a design document, and basic game design principles; how to analyze and evaluate a game; help student understand the psychological, social, and other factors that create âfunâ behind a game and related game theories; help students understand the history of video game, different genres of game, aesthetics and cultural issues in games, the politics and social issues in multiplayer games, and the basic of game technology and game prototyping tools.

descriptionEn: The many new forms of (digital) screens for moving images sprouting in our urban space indicate the need to reconsider established methods and standards of imaging. “Micro-narratives” is a neologism created for such a purpose: (1) to reflect upon the unspoken (historical) assumptions of existing norms and conventions in order to (2) facilitate free experimentation with new possibilities in making moving images by seeking new sources of inspiration.

descriptionEn: Globalisation and global trade in livestock products have created new challenges for governments and international organisations (WOAH, WHO, FAO, WTO) in predicting, preventing and controlling transboundary diseases, which can be defined as epidemic diseases which are highly contagious or transmissible and have the potential for very rapid spread, irrespective of national borders, causing serious socio-economic and public health consequences.
departmentText: Department of Infectious Diseases and Public Health
departments: Department of Infectious Diseases and Public Health
descriptionZhHans: 牲畜产品的全球化和全球贸易给各国政府和国际组织(WOAH、卫生组织、粮农组织、世贸组织)在预测、预防和控制跨界疾病方面带来了新的挑战。 跨界疾病可被界定为具有高度传染性或可传播性的流行病，有可能迅速蔓延，而不论国界如何，造成严重的社会经济和公共卫生后果。
descriptionZhHant: 牲畜產品的全球化和全球貿易給各國政府和國際組織(WOAH、衛生組織、糧農組織、世貿組織)在預測、預防和控制跨界疾病方面帶來了新的挑戰。 跨界疾病可被界定爲具有高度傳染性或可傳播性的流行病，有可能迅速蔓延，而不論國界如何，造成嚴重的社會經濟和公共衛生後果。

descriptionEn: This course integrates and builds on the foundations of pre-clinical courses including The Animal Body, Function and Dysfunction, Host, Agent and Defence, and Veterinary Practice and Professional Studies.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程整合并借鉴了临床前课程的基础，包括动物身体、功能和功能、宿主、代理人和辩护、兽医实践和专业研究。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程整合並借鑑了臨牀前課程的基礎，包括動物身體、功能和功能、宿主、代理人和辯護、獸醫實踐和專業研究。

descriptionEn: This course covers the theoretical and practical approach to surgical principles, wound management and common surgical disorders and diseases including soft tissue as well as musculoskeletal abnormalities.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程涵盖手术原理的理论和实践方法、伤口管理、常见的手术障碍和疾病，包括软组织以及肌肉骨骼异常。
descriptionZhHant: 該課程涵蓋手術原理的理論和實踐方法、傷口管理、常見的手術障礙和疾病，包括軟組織以及肌肉骨骼異常。

descriptionEn: This course builds on the foundation of the modules 'Animal Body', 'Function and Dysfunction' and 'Clinical Pharmacology/ Toxicology'.

descriptionEn: Clinical pathology is a fundamental science which will be utilized throughout the career of veterinarians and forms part of the day one competencies for completion of the Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine offered at CityUHK.
descriptionZhHans: 临床病理学是一门基础科学，将在整个兽医生涯中加以利用，成为完成市立大学提供的兽医学士学位的第一天能力的一部分。

descriptionEn: This course builds on the clinical reasoning and problem-solving skills developed in Small Animal Clinical Studies 1 to be able to diagnose and treat common medical disorders of dogs and cats.
descriptionZhHans: 该课程以小动物临床研究1中培养的临床推理和解决问题技能为基础，能够诊断和治疗狗猫常见的医疗障碍。

descriptionEn: The Production Animal Clinical Studies course is structured around the investigative approach, forming a comprehensive framework that students can build on as they integrate material from Livestock Husbandry, Animal Nutrition and Welfare, Function and Dysfunction, and Host, Agent and Defence, and assimilate knowledge and skills during this course.
descriptionZhHans: 动物临床生产研究课程是围绕调查方法安排的，它形成了一个综合框架，学生可以在此基础上学习畜牧学、动物营养和福利、功能和功能、宿主、代理人和国防等材料，并在此课程中吸收知识和技能。
